verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LangSmith being operated through its UI, API, SDKs and an official MCP server, but no first-party natural-language command interface. The MCP server and REST API belong to other stories (agent connectivity and programmatic access) and are building blocks, not the product itself accepting natural-language commands. LangSmith Engine automates issue detection and diagnosis, but nothing says it takes natural-language instructions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
